model.description: Tower Three presents Half Pint 4, a premium 3.5g flower offering that delivers quality cannabis in a convenient eighth-ounce format. This carefully cultivated flower showcases the brand's commitment to excellence, providing a versatile experience suitable for any time of day. Each bud is hand-selected and expertly cured to preserve natural terpenes and cannabinoids, ensuring optimal potency and flavor. The flower features a complex aroma profile with earthy, herbal notes complemented by subtle sweet undertones. Whether you're rolling your own or packing a bowl, this 3.5g jar provides the perfect amount for personal enjoyment or sharing with friends. Tower Three's dedication to quality cultivation practices shines through in every nug, delivering smooth smoke and satisfying effects. Ideal for both seasoned enthusiasts and newcomers exploring premium flower options.
